name: com.homefixngo/home-fix-n-go
title: Home Fix N Go
description: Home repairs and refurbishments in Eastbourne, UK: check your area, send quote requests with photos.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who Home Fix N Go are, how to reach them, opening hours, how pricing works and what they do not do in-house.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every service with a one-line summary, what it includes and its page URL.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full detail of one service: what it includes, things to know and its FAQs.

tools.name: list_customer_types
tools.description: The customer types served (flats and houses, landlords, holiday lets, hotels, businesses) with what each page covers.

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Checks whether a town, village or Eastbourne neighbourhood is in the service area (about 20 km around Eastbourne).

place.description: Town, village, neighbourhood or postcode district

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: The questions customers ask most, answered by the team (pricing, materials, payment, areas, electrics).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The text of any public page on homefixngo.com, by URL or path (for example /how-we-price/). The pages are listed in https://homefixngo.com/llms.txt and https://homefixngo.com/sitemap-index.xml.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends the customer's job straight to the Home Fix N Go team as a free quote request, with the customer's own name and phone, only with their permission, and with their photos if they have any (photo for one attached file, photos for up to 8 links or base64 images). The team is notified at once and replies with a free fixed price, usually the same day: the customer does not need to visit the website. Nothing is booked or charged. Returns a reference to give the customer, how many photos arrived, and an optional WhatsApp link for adding more photos or a video. Do not send photos of documents, payment cards or ID. Use dry_run to check everything, photos included, without sending.

job_description.description: What needs doing, room by room if more than one thing

property.description: e.g. second-floor flat, terraced house, 8-room guest house

timing.description: When they would like it done

materials.description: Whether they want the team to supply materials or already have them

photo.description: One photo the customer attached (a file the customer shared in the chat)

url.description: A public https link to the image

download_url.description: A temporary download link to a file the customer attached

data.description: The image as base64 (no data: prefix needed), at most 15 MB

items.description: One photo: a link we can download (url or download_url) or the image itself as base64 (data).

url.description: A public https link to the image

download_url.description: A temporary download link to a file the customer attached

data.description: The image as base64 (no data: prefix needed), at most 15 MB

photos.description: Up to 8 photos of the job: a wide shot and close-ups help most

ai_assessment.description: What you can see in the customer's photos, in plain words (for example: black mould along the bath sealant, the grout is cracked)

assistant.description: Your name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without sending anything
